description: Align Technology, Inc. is a global medical device company primarily engaged in the design, manufacture and marketing of Invisalign clear aligners for the treatment of malocclusions by orthodontists and general dental practitioners, Vivera retainers for retention, iTero intraoral scanners and services for dentistry, and exocad computer-aided design and computer-aided manufacturing software for dental laboratories and dental practitioners. Its vision and strategy is to revolutionize orthodontic and restorative dentistry through digital treatment planning and implementation using the Align Digital Platform, an integrated suite of proprietary technologies and services designed to deliver a seamless, end-to-end solution for patients, consumers, orthodontists, general dental practitioners and lab partners.
